category: multi-host premium link generator plus torrent leech (Vietnamese)

free_tier.stated: No free allowance; a paid entry tier is advertised at '99.000đ' on the order pages, while the published price table starts at PREMIUM M1 149,000 VND for 30 days.
free_tier.notes: The 99,000đ banner and the 149,000đ M1 table are both on the vendor's pages today and were not reconciled; the record prices the M1 tier it can quote in full.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated; the quota is a daily byte allowance, not a per-file cap

retention.stated: not applicable: a direct link is returned, the file is not stored for a user

egress.terms: Daily byte allowance per tier, unused volume rolls over: 'Dung lượng không dùng hết được cộng dồn sang hôm sau'. M1 is 10 GB/day (300 GB/month) with a 40 GB first day; VIP 12 is 50 GB/day with 200 GB first day. Bandwidth is quoted at 1000 Mbps to 10 Gbps.

interface_detail: Web panel: paste a host link or a magnet, receive a direct link. A free Vietnamese proxy is bundled with every tier ('Miễn phí Proxy Việt Nam').
tooling: Browser panel plus IDM; torrent and magnet leech is a first-class tab rather than an add-on; no API or rclone backend documented.
chaining: The free Vietnamese proxy is the distinctive part: it lets a client outside Vietnam pull a link that is geo-shaped to Vietnamese networks, which is what the FPT/VNPT/Viettel-hosted servers are for. Chains with any download manager.

limits.value: 10 GB/day on PREMIUM M1, 20 GB/day on M24; 25-50 GB/day on VIP tiers
first-day bonus 40-200 GB depending on tier

limits_note: 150+ hosts supported; the vendor name-checks Rapidgator, Alfafile, FileFactory and K2S as the headline four.
binding_note: the top tier's 50 GB/day is the only one that clears 34 GB/day.

identity_cost.detail: The order form asks for a phone number and email ('Bạn vui lòng điền số điện thoại và email vào form dưới đây'), then payment by 'chuyển khoản ngân hàng hoặc Ví điện tử' with a QR scanned 'trên App của 52 ngân hàng và ví Momo, ZaloPay, Viettel Money'. Settlement needs a Vietnamese bank app or a Vietnamese wallet; no card rail is offered.

reliability_note: Account details are emailed after a QR payment clears, so a failed or mistyped transfer leaves no order record; bandwidth claims (1000 Mbps to 10 Gbps, 2500+ TB/month capacity) are vendor-stated and unmeasured.
confidence_note: The price page, the order page and the payment instructions were read today. The payment rail is the load-bearing claim and comes from the order page's own text, not a third party.

evidence.proved: tier table: 'PREMIUM M1 30 ngày 149,000 VNĐ, Dung lượng 10GB/ngày, 40Gb cho ngày đầu'; 'VIP 12 365 ngày 2,999,000 VNĐ, 50GB/ngày'; 'Hỗ trợ Rapidgator, Alfafile, FileFactory, K2S & 150+ Filehost'; 'Proxy Việt Nam'

payment rail: 'Mua tài khoản Get link PRE - M1 bằng chuyển khoản ngân hàng hoặc Ví điện tử'; QR 'trên App của 52 ngân hàng và ví Momo, ZaloPay, Viettel Money'; 'Bạn vui lòng điền số điện thoại và email'
price table restated and the '99.000đ' entry banner

price_per_tb_month: VND 149,000 per 30 days for 10 GB/day (about VND 497,000 per TiB at the monthly cap)
notes: Same market as LinksVIP, opposite payment answer: Getlink.vn quotes a lower per-GB price and bundles a Vietnamese proxy, but takes only Vietnamese rails. The pair is the cleanest demonstration that the gate is payment, not capability. Abandonment condition: a card rail appears.

extras.servers: 15+ Vietnamese 10Gbps at FPT/VNPT/Viettel; 25+ foreign 10Gbps at Singapore, US, Japan, Canada, France, Germany
extras.capacity_claim: 2500+ TB per month, 15000+ active accounts (vendor-stated, unmeasured)
extras.tiers: PREMIUM M1/M3/M6/M12/M24 plus VIP 1/3/6/12 and Super VIP
